question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A group of fish swimming together
solution:
The correct answer is: **Shoal**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A **shoal **is a group of fish swimming together. (मछलियों का एक समूह एक साथ तैर रहा है)

 
 
• **Example**: *As we approached the shore, we marvelled at the dazzling shoal of fish swimming gracefully beneath the clear water.*
 
 
 
• It is a one-word substitute for the given group of words.
 
• The word 'shoal
